title: SAFRB Mobility Capacity Envelope Report v0.1

claim_ceiling.const: Structurally compiles externally marked-admitted route-capacity records into scenario- and departure-period-specific bounded mobility constraints. This does not authenticate source bytes, issuer authority, physical identity, measurement truth, route condition, scenario completeness, dispatch authorization or delivered field service.

description: Contains complete schedule-admission receipts and the compiled mobility instance. Consumers must call the independent verifier against the original envelope before using the compiled instance.
